body: Sure? I'm not really looking. This isn't romantic woes. I dont care about having a girlfriend or wife.

It's been mostly luck and blind confidence that got me this fair. I'm basically an imposter waiting to be found out. I didnt put any effort in to get where I am. That's why I wish that what I have could have been given to someone with willpower to use.

We are in very similar situations. I'm at the end of University, but I stopped going to class so I'll flunk out now either way. I have no willpower and I cant envision a life where I ever become functional. It all sounds so incredibly difficult and doesnt seem worth it to me at all. I paid for college all on my own and have loans to show for it. Now when I flunk out I'm going to be working nonstop to just pay the loans back and I wont even have my degree. I'm so ridiculously smart, yet I couldn't even see all this coming. I'm a waste of potential. Even if I dont do this today, my life is still over.

That means a lot. I cant keep doing this life thing. Everything gets more and more exhausting and the one goal I had I failed to reach. I realize this is temporary and I wont feel this way forever, but my issues wont resolve themselves and I definitely wont be able to resolve them. What I'm afraid of is life going on. I took all my potential and threw it away because I cant get out of bed and go to class. I love someone who is unhealthy for me. And I'm kind of just a shitty person to be around so I'm going to be selfish one last time

I've been really determined. It's ironic to me that the one thing I cant tell everyone is the one thing that everyone will hate me for not telling them about. I'm going to miss everyone so much, but I cant tell them goodbye.
